'''Bettina Valeska Lotsch''' (born 7 September 1977 in [[Frankenthal]] (Pfalz)) is a German chemist.<ref name="www.fkf.mpg.de">{{Cite web|url=https://www.fkf.mpg.de/171992/Curriculum_Vitae|title=Curriculum Vitae|website=www.fkf.mpg.de|access-date=31 January 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190201065821/https://www.fkf.mpg.de/171992/Curriculum_Vitae|archive-date=1 February 2019}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://portal.dnb.de/opac.htm?method=simpleSearch&cqlMode=true&query=nid%3D132804336|title=Katalog der Deutschen Nationalbibliothek|website=portal.dnb.de|access-date=3 February 2019}}</ref> She is Director at the [[Max Planck Institute for Solid State Research]] in Stuttgart, Germany.

== Life ==
Lotsch studied chemistry at [[LMU Munich]] and graduated in 2000.<ref name="www.fkf.mpg.de" /> In 2006, she completed her dissertation in the group of {{ill|Wolfgang Schnick|de}} at LMU.<ref name="www.fkf.mpg.de" /> From 2007 to 2008, she worked as a [[postdoctoral researcher]] in the group of [[Geoffrey Ozin|G. A. Ozin]] at the [[University of Toronto]].<ref name="www.fkf.mpg.de" /> From 2009 to the beginning of 2017, she was an assistant professor at LMU,<ref name="www.fkf.mpg.de" /> as well as an independent group leader for the [[Max Planck Institute for Solid State Research]].<ref name="www.fkf.mpg.de" /> In 2017, she became Director of the [[Max Planck Institute for Solid State Research]] and an honorary professor at LMU.<ref name="www.fkf.mpg.de" />

== Research ==
Her research focuses on rational materials synthesis at the interface of solid-state chemistry, materials chemistry, and nanochemistry.<ref name="www.fkf.mpg.de" /> Materials of her research interest are:<ref name="www.fkf.mpg.de" />

* New materials for energy conversion and storage (e.g., porous frameworks, lithium solid electrolytes for all-solid-state batteries)<ref name="www.fkf.mpg.de" />
* Photonic nanostructures for optical sensing<ref name="www.fkf.mpg.de" />
* 2D nanosheet materials and artificial heterostructures<ref name="www.fkf.mpg.de" />
